title: Informal: FY26-ENG-50: Jacaman Road & McPherson Road – Site Improvements (Phase 3) Engineering Department

onscreen_lines.desc: Street Paving 6” Reinforced Concrete Flatwork / Median - Furnish all resources required to construct a reinforced concrete sidewalk in accordance with City Specifications/standard details and provided construction plans. Scope includes but is not limited to mobilization, site preparation, furnishing and placing concrete/reinforcement, jointing, doweling, and curing. All work Shall be bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Traffic Control System Improvements Traffic Control All labor and equipment required to provide site safety and traffic management per City Specifications and Plan Specifications. Scope includes but is not limited to all temporary traffic control devices, pedestrian detours for sidewalk construction, daily maintenance of the work zone, obtaining necessary permits, implementing lane closures. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Traffic Control System Improvements Pavement Striping All labor and equipment required to provide the layout and application of high-visibility traffic-grade markings to the cured asphalt surface in Strict accordance with plans, ADA standards and per City Specifications. Scope includes but is not limited to the application of premium acrylic waterborne or thermoplastic paint to define all parking stalls, directional arrows, and fire lanes, ensuring crisp edges and a uniform wet film thickness of 15 to 18 mils. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Traffic Control System Improvements Pavement Marking Symbols Pavement Marking Symbols - All labor and equipment required to provide the layout and application of high-visibility traffic-grade markings symbols to the cured asphalt surface in strict accordance with plans, ADA standards and per City Specifications. Scope includes but is not limited to the application of premium acrylic waterborne or thermoplastic paint to define all directional arrows symbols, etc., ensuring crisp edges and a uniform wet film thickness of 15 to 18 mils. For designated accessible spaces, the work specifically includes the application of Handicap Blue backgrounds with a white International Symbol of Accessibility (ISA) stencil, along with the required cross-hatched loading zones. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Storm Water Pollution Prevention Concrete Washout Pit Furnish all labor, equipment, and materials to install, maintain, and eventually remove a designated leak-proof concrete washout facility in accordance with City Specifications and environmental regulations. Scope includes the containment of all concrete-related wastewater and solids, regular maintenance to prevent overflow, and the legal disposal of all accumulated waste off-site. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Storm Water Pollution Prevention Trash & Debris Containment Furnish all resources to prevent the accumulation of waste, scrap, and rubbish on the project site or adjacent residential properties as per city standards. Item includes providing secured containment for all construction debris, preventing wind-blown litter, and ensuring the roadway and sidewalks remain free of tracked dirt and trash. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.

Storm Water Pollution Prevention Curb Inlet Protection (Hog Wire Weir) Furnish all resources required for the installation, maintenance, and eventual removal of hog wire weir curb inlet protection as indicated on the Construction Plans and in compliance with local erosion and sediment control standards. Scope includes, but is not limited to, the provision and assembly of hog wire fencing, wire mesh, and geotextile filter fabric, secured with aggregate-filled bags or mechanical anchors to create a functional sediment-filtering weir. The contractor is responsible for routine inspections and the timely removal of accumulated silt and debris to maintain flow capacity and prevent localized flooding; any bypass or damage to the storm sewer system resulting from improper maintenance shall be repaired at the contractor’s sole expense. Bid as "Complete-in-Place," covering all labor, materials, and incidentals necessary for a fully compliant and finished installation.

Demolition Removal of Existing Pavement Striping Furnish all labor, equipment, materials, and traffic control necessary for the complete removal and disposal of existing conflicting pavement markings (including lines, symbols, and arrows) along the avenue project limits. Work shall be performed using an approved non-destructive method (e.g., water-blasting or grinding) that minimizes damage to the underlying asphalt or concrete surface. Disposal of all generated debris shall be the sole responsibility of the Contractor as indicated on the Construction Plans and in accordance with City and Environmental Regulations. Bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.
Project Completion Estimated time in working days to complete project after notice of receipt to proceed.
